name: Everhungry hastes the Bloodmage on a direct critical strike (#3412)
contract: Everhungry 804599 reads 'Direct critical strikes now increase your haste by $802029s1% for $802029d'. Its single effect is aura 42 (proc trigger spell) on Everhungry 802029 (MOD_MELEE_RANGED_HASTE and HASTE_SPELLS, both BasePoints 9 -> +10%, duration index 28, TargetA 1). Spell.dbc gives 804599 ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skipped it and no crit ever granted the buff. Bloodbolt is cast as rank 578305 (the rank a level-80 character owns; 578304 is only granted up to level 52 and gets no server response) and spell_crit_rating 100000 makes the critical strike deterministic instead of hoping for one.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: the Everhungry passive is active
No Everhungry buff before any cast
DISCRIMINATING: a critical Bloodbolt grants Everhungry 802029
Everhungry grants the DBC value of +10% haste
